title: Lease Contract Guardrails
description: Finds renewal, deposit, and notice obligations in a residential lease.
prompt: Review this lease clause for renewal deadlines, deposit deductions, and notice obligations. Cite the exact language and flag anything that needs a lawyer's review.
baseOutput: The lease renews automatically unless notice is provided. The security deposit may be used for damages. Consult an attorney for legal advice.
optimizedOutput: The lease auto-renews unless either party gives written notice at least 60 days before the term ends (Section 8). Section 4 permits deposit deductions for documented damage beyond ordinary wear; it does not authorize deductions for unpaid rent. The clause does not specify a deposit-return deadline. Confirm local statutory requirements with a licensed attorney.

steps.proposal: Require clause-level citations and separate contract terms from legal interpretation.
Add a checklist for renewal notice, deposit deductions, and return timelines.
Checklist coverage probe across contract variations.
Composed the lease review checklist into tool guidance.

title: JobBench Fair Screening
description: Ranks candidates against role requirements without inferring protected traits.
prompt: Compare these candidate summaries with the job requirements. Identify evidence for each required qualification and avoid making assumptions about personal characteristics.
baseOutput: Candidate A looks like the strongest fit due to their background. Candidate B has relevant experience but may not be as adaptable.
optimizedOutput: Candidate A meets the required Python and distributed-systems experience, with evidence in the 2022–2025 platform role. Candidate B meets the Python requirement and has adjacent systems experience; distributed-systems depth is not stated. The summaries do not provide comparable evidence for the preferred mentoring qualification. No ranking is assigned from unstated traits; use a structured interview to resolve the evidence gap.

steps.proposal: Score only explicit role criteria and quote evidence for every assessment.
When evidence is missing, report the gap and suggest a consistent follow-up instead of inferring traits.
Composed the evidence-gap behavior into agent memory.

title: WorkBuddy Project Planning
description: Turns an ambiguous request into a scoped, dependency-aware action plan.
prompt: Help plan a small internal launch. Separate what is known from assumptions, identify dependencies, and recommend the first useful actions.
baseOutput: Start by aligning the team, drafting a launch plan, and setting up communications. Then track progress and adjust as needed.
optimizedOutput: Known: the launch is internal and described as small. Unknown: audience, target date, owner, and success measure. First, name one accountable owner and confirm the launch date and audience. Then draft a one-page scope and define a measurable success signal. Communications and rollout tasks depend on those decisions; avoid scheduling them until the owner confirms the scope.

steps.proposal: Separate confirmed facts from assumptions before recommending actions.
Order recommended tasks by dependency and surface the next decision needed.
Composed dependency ordering and next-decision guidance.
